liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Cat Sunflower** (2 reviews): China Cat into I Know You Rider is called loose and scampering, a highlight of the show; China Cat into Rider, with the Feelin' Groovy jam, is called possibly the tightest ever performed [12][22]
- **He's Gone** (2 reviews): Second set drifts into space out of He's Gone and wanders a long while, with Jerry meandering; The He's Gone medley has jamming between songs that foreshadows later Space; Jerry's vocals are emotional [13][21]
- **Brown Eyed Women** (1 review): Jerry delivers a fine Brown Eyed Women after a subdued first five or six numbers [14]
- **Candyman** (1 review): A rare Candyman appears in the first set after Big River gets things jumping [14]
- **Weather Report Suite Part 1** (1 review): Weather Report Suite is huge, with Jerry commanding climactic leads [22]
- **Around and Around** (1 review): The spoken 'step back' rap before Around and Around is praised as the best the reviewer has heard [11]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): The turn from He's Gone into Truckin' seems driven by lack of better ideas, not natural evolution [12]
- **The Other One** (1 review): The Other One is described as a sprawling beast [22]

## The recordings

- **gd73-12-08.sbd.gustin.1811.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 38 songs; 266 min; rated 3.43/5 by 7 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer describes the soundboard as good sound [13]
- **gd1973-12-08.152573.aud.lamarre.vernon.sirmick.flac24**: audience recording; 34 songs; 220 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]. Said about its sound: Tape had degenerated, requiring many repairs and patches; Big River was very muddy, but EQ revealed a pretty good recording [3]
- **gd1973-12-08.sbd.unknown.7586.shnf**: soundboard; 35 songs; 215 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [5]
- **gd1973-12-08.167899.sbd-patched.minches.flac16**: soundboard; 31 songs; 220 min [8]

## Around the show

- Phil complains at the end that his feet hurt and asks where his seat is; Bobby replies no one moved [19]
- Reviewer ranks it among the very best 1973 shows and one of their most memorable concerts [11]
- Reviewer says the 9-08-73 show has a similar setlist and rocks harder than this one [12]
- Reviewer says it is easily overlooked because much heavier 1973 shows come directly before and after it [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd73-12-08.sbd.gustin.1811.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Reviewer says the Playin'>Uncle John's>Dew>Uncle John's>Playin' filler clearly comes from a different source than the rest; Soundboard lineage runs through MR, cassette, DAT, CD, EAC and SHN, via Kirby (Chalupa) Bell [1][15]
- **gd1973-12-08.152573.aud.lamarre.vernon.sirmick.flac24**: taped by from the collection of Doug Lamarre; transferred by SIRMick & Matt Vernon; source: Unknown Audience Cassette (high gen) [3]
- **gd1973-12-08.sbd.unknown.7586.shnf**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Unknown; source: Stereo Soundboard > Master Reel > ? > CD > SHN [5]. Also: Reviewer points to the Gustin soundboard for Me and My Uncle, suggesting this version lacks it [18]
- **gd1973-12-08.167899.sbd-patched.minches.flac16**: transferred by Mastered by Charlie Miller & Scott Clugston March 15, 2018  Patching, editing and tagging by David Minches June 23, 2024; source: This version patches SHNID# 141376 which had several gaps. [8]. Also: Soundboard has patches, pitch-adjusted and EQ'd to match, in China Cat Sunflower, Around and Around, Greatest Story and The Other One [8]

## Art and photos

- Poster by www.soundstreet.us: [Grateful Dead at Duke 12/08/73 | Soundstreet.us](https://www.soundstreet.us/grateful-dead-at-duke-120873/) [28]
